answer_1.quote: We introduce DischargeSim, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates large language models (LLMs) in the role of discharge educators... The DoctorAgent must not only deliver accurate information but also apply appropriate strategies... Post-conversation Output Generation... DoctorAgent is tasked with producing two personalized documents... 1) Personalized Discharge Summary... 2) Structured AHRQ-style Checklist...
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn discharge dialogues and personalized discharge summaries/checklists

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L, BLEURT, UMLS-F1 to evaluate discharge summaries... We also employ LLM-Judge evaluation criteria... The table reports results across three metric categories: (1) Traditional Generation Evaluation Metrics including ROUGE-L, BLEURT, UMLS-F, and Exam Accuracy...

answer_3.quote: We adopt LLM-as-Judge, specifically using DeepSeek-V3, to evaluate each conversation across two main dimensions... For summary evaluation we also use DeepSeek-V3-Judge across eight dimensions...

answer_4.quote: Two licensed clinicians (one nurse and one physician) independently provided pairwise preferences between two nurse-agent outputs per case... Experts selected a preferred output and highlighted supporting evidence spans... Agreement between the two experts was high: Cohen's κ = 0.715...
answer_4.guideline: Experts evaluated outputs on five criteria: (i) Language Delivery, (ii) Human-Centered Communication, (iii) Content Coverage, (iv) Education Strategy, and (v) Overall Preference.
